Technology stocks eased slightly from their mid-day highs on Friday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 0.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 1.0%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Cypress Semiconductor ( CY ) was set to finish almost 6% higher on Friday after the chipmaker exceeded Wall Street estimates with its Q4 financial resuls, including non-GAAP earnings of $0.35 per share and topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.02 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Proofpoint ( PFPT ) jumped out to a 12% gain after reporting non-GAAP Q4 net income of $0.51 per share, up from $0.37 per share during the same quarter last year and beating consensus estimates by $0.16 per share. Revenue rose 35% year-over-year, also topping Street views.
(+) Symantec ( SYMC ) rose over 9% after late Thursday reporting fiscal Q3 net income of $0.44 per share on $1.22 billion in revenue, exceeding the analyst means by $0.05 per share and $40 million, respectively.
(-) Celestica ( CLS ) dropped 19% on Friday after the electronics contract manufacturer missed Wall Street estimates with its Q4 earnings results. It also issued a mixed Q1 forecast and received a downgrade to neutral from outperform at Macquarie.
